title: Governed redispatch after WORK_ITEM_UNBLOCKED — READY with exact unblock-event provenance + canonically-terminal bound predecessors becomes eligible for ONE new mission attempt
description: READY+terminal-bound items could never be redispatched autonomously (review=INTERVENTION, launchable required no bound mission). REOPENABLE requires proveCanonicalUnblockProvenance (ONE authority shared by review + dispatch boundary): CURRENT READY must come from authentic WORK_ITEM_UNBLOCKED (exact mint shape BLOCKED->READY, actor operator:*, LAST status event) AND the status event IMMEDIATELY preceding it must be a canonical TERMINAL FOLD — WORK_ITEM_SYNCED/{,STATUS_} produced by PAIR_BUSINESS_LAYER, metadata.mission_id pinned to the LATEST bound mission, metadata.mission_status terminal — with strict causal ordering on durable GLOBAL seq: fold.seq > bound-mission terminal-transition seq AND > last mission_runtime spine seq. An operator WORK_ITEM_BLOCKED episode, unrelated BLOCKED, older-linked-fold reuse, or pre-terminal unblock never authorizes. R3-F4: runtime evidence uses canonical MRT_<missionId> id (prior raw-id lookup matched no events, skipping the check); spine restricted to CREATED/TRANSITION; proven terminal runtime event (seq < fold seq) required — missing evidence fails closed. REWORK/ROLLED_BACK/malformed/mis-ordered/superseded unblocks -> INTERVENTION; fresh READY stays ACTIVE; derived-status validator unweakened. proveDispatchAuthority re-proves the SAME corrected contract AT the openWorkItem crossing + EVERY WOB attempt canonically terminal + latest bound lifecycle; WAL/objective/budget strict. Tests 15/15: HB13 pre-terminal unblock (BLOCK pauses, unblock while PAUSED, mission later CANCELLED) never redispatches; HB14 older linked fold vs unrelated latest episode rejected; HB1 valid terminal fold->unblock->1 attempt; HB9-12 REWORK/ROLLED_BACK/malformed/superseded/beforeOpen-drift fail closed; HB7 real scheduler admission (tick->claimable->claim; forged binding denied; revoked->POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE); dup tick+restart=1; mission-cap; A+B consume. 162 regression pass; baseline f4 R5.1-crash identical on BASE.
